title: What the Pronghorn runs on

is_this_you.pressure: You say the true thing too early and too loud. By evening you forget it. They keep it for a week.
is_this_you.love: You fall at full speed. The one who keeps you can run beside you and still get you to stop.
is_this_you.cost: You start five fires and tend two. The other three burn on, and you hear about them later.

opener.text: Mars rules Aries [wiki-aries]. In Chinese, Mars is 火星 (huǒxīng), the Fire Star [wochinese]. Its old name, 荧惑 (yínghuò), was read as an omen of disorder [wochinese]. Your year animal burns too. The Horse is yang Fire, the branch of noon [wiki-horse] [wiki-branches]. Fire on fire. No water between. You came in at a run.

tabs.label: Speed
tabs.intro: First to move, last to tire.

rows.text: Aries is cardinal Fire, the first sign, the pioneer [wiki-aries] [almanac-aries]. The Horse is lively and perceptive, and bad at hiding what it feels [tcg-horse]. One starts. The other keeps going. In you that makes a fast start and a long engine. Your face breaks the news first.

The old books call Aries brave and forthright, and also rash and impatient [wiki-aries]. The Horse's listed flaw is impulse [tcg-horse]. So you leap first. Mostly you land well. When you don't, you left before the ground was clear.

tabs.label: Who can keep pace
tabs.intro: Three who run with you. One who trips you.
tabs.love_lead: In love you fall fast and need space. You show care by doing things side by side at speed, and a road trip says it better than a card. Three old pairings run your way.

tabs.label: Where to run
tabs.intro: Pick a long road. Then take it.

rows.text: Emergency calls and breaking news both pay for the first move. Travel China Guide lists adventure and tour work among the Horse's trades [tcg-horse].

Pronghorn have used one route between Grand Teton and the Upper Green River for at least 6,000 years [wcs-path]. In 2008 it became the first federally designated wildlife migration corridor in the US [wcs-path]. Speed is half your story. The other half is a road you keep coming back to.

easy.why: The Lanner Falcon (Sagittarius, Tiger year) runs on double harmony: Tiger and Horse share a trine, and Sagittarius trines Aries among the fire signs [wiki-zodiac] [wiki-aspect].
The Harpy Eagle (Leo, Tiger year) shares the Tiger and Horse trine, and Leo trines Aries as a fellow fire sign [wiki-zodiac] [wiki-aspect].
The Bar-headed Goose (Sagittarius, Goat year) is your secret friend, since Horse and Goat form a Six Harmonies pair [wiki-zodiac].

hard.why: The hard one is the Coconut Crab (Cancer, Rat year): the Rat clashes with the Horse, and Cancer squares Aries [wiki-zodiac] [wiki-aspect].

story.text: The Arapaho word for the pronghorn is nisíce [arapaho]. Children wore amulets of antelope horn so they would grow and walk quickly, and the same kind of charm was used to make horses run faster [arapaho].

closing: Fire Star above, open ground ahead. Go.
